liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Willie And The Hand Jive** (2 reviews, 1 other source): Reviewer calls Willie and the Hand Jive a rare song to find in a show; Reviewer calls the Hand Jive stellar [3][29][34]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer, who attended, describes The Other One as a monster with a 'wolf call' quality [30]
- **Gimme Some Lovin'** (1 review): Reviewer first heard the Dead play Gimme Some Lovin' live at this show, and loved it [33]
- Reviewer singles out the Deal as a tasty highlight with strong Jerry guitar soloing [29]
- Around the 5:30 mark of the Deal jam, the attending reviewer had a revelatory moment [33]
- Reviewer loves this Deal, saying it keeps on giving [39]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd86-03-23 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t02 Gimme Some Lovin'**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t03 Deal**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t04 Willie & The Hand Jive**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t05 Candyman**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t06 Cassidy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t07 West LA Fadeaway**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]
- **gd86-03-23 t08 Mama Tried**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [40]

## The recordings

- **gd1986-03-23.141998.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1986-03-23.156077.beyerm201-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 20 songs; 127 min [3]. Said about its sound: A grinding PA noise, probably Weir's rig distorting, runs through the music on this whole spring tour [3]
- **gd1986-03-23.172448.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 19 songs; 137 min [8]
- **gd86-03-23.senn.unknown.15203.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 139 min; rated 4.29/5 by 7 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the recording's sound quality as excellent and worth downloading; Sound is decent, and equalization can improve it [28][29]
- **gd1986-03-23.nakcm304.suraci.sbeok.79879.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 134 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [22]. Said about its sound: Tony Suraci's audience recording is among the best-sounding audience tapes from this 1986 tour, per the reviewer [34]

## Around the show

- Shakedown Street into Samson and Delilah echoes the pairing played at the 1985 Spectrum show [30]
- Reviewer ranks this show as the best of 1986, alongside the Kaiser run [30]
- Reviewer thinks the opening run of Gimme Some Lovin', Deal and Hand Jive ranks among the strongest first-set openers in years [36]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1986-03-23.141998.fob.oade.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.wise.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Jim Wise; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41 mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]. Also: A 1.2-second patch at the end of Mama Tried comes from Tony Suraci's Nakamichi 304 source [1]
- **gd1986-03-23.156077.beyerm201-murtha.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Mike Davis, Kenny Davis, Sean Murtha, Gary Steel? Kyle Holbrook? Tom Pinney; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Microphones: Beyer m201 (hypercardioid) XY 90º Recorder: Sony TC-D5M No Dolby Location: 40' from stage; DFC; chest height on stand This Source: 1st Gen AUDCA… [3]. Also: Some tracks missing from the master tapes were replaced using another source, SHN ID 111956 [3]
- **gd1986-03-23.172448.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 shotguns > Sony D5M [8]. Also: Taped on Nakamichi 304 by Stephen Thomas, from master cassettes; a 0:17 patch in Drums comes from the Oade Schoeps source [8]
- **gd86-03-23.senn.unknown.15203.sbeok.shnf**: source: MAC (Sony TCD5M 2Sennheiser ME-80 & 2 Sennheiser 441's) > wav > shn [14]. Also: For about twenty years, only an audience recording of this show circulated; reviewer wonders where the soundboard is [33]
- **gd1986-03-23.nakcm304.suraci.sbeok.79879.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: Nak CM304's>SonyD5 [22]
